text:
Pri (CS): FYI I pulled the onboarding feedback batch and 15 asks landed in the billing/exports bucket. Need a quick safety check before we promise any per-route exports. Markers: :white_check_mark: = roadmap, :mag: = needs research, :no_entry: = privacy/legal block

feedback-bot: Imported onboarding_feedback_2026_07_12.csv (15 rows). Auto-tags: per-route-billing, exports, invoices, PII-risk

Mason (PM): Can we get a short decision tree: what fields are ok in an export, what needs masking, what is a hard no?

Zoe (Product Ops): Added a column "privacy_flag" to the triage sheet and added sample invoices link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/triage-1798887777 (placeholder)

Pri (CS): paste of 3 rows for context:
```
customer,tier,ask
NorthNode,A,export per-route CSV with route_id, tokens, cost
MediLink,A,export invoice with user_id and full prompt text for internal audit
TinyApp,C,ability to export per-route usage with sample_request_payload
```

Kei (Eng): quick callout: exporting any raw prompt text or unredacted user_id is a privacy no unless the customer owns that data and has a signed DPA + explicit opt-in. Aggregated metrics (route_id, total_tokens, cost) are fine.

legal-bot: Note: policy snippet - "Raw user content must not be exported without customer explicit consent and review by Legal. User identifiers must be hashed or tokenized for exports used outside secure environments."

Mason (PM): Reacting :white_check_mark: to NorthNode (aggregated export OK). Reacting :no_entry: to MediLink as written. For TinyApp, :mag: - need to know if sample_request_payload includes PII.

Pri (CS): I'll mark MediLink as renewal-risk if they insist on raw prompts; will ask them for use-case to see if we can propose a compliant alternative.

Kei (Eng): Technical alternatives: 1) on-demand manual redaction run (ops-assisted) 2) hashed user_id + content-hash only 3) customer-side log forwarding for private deployments. All require notices in the support docs.

Zoe (Product Ops): I'll add a "recommended_pattern" column to the sheet and capture the three alternatives. Scheduling a 20-min quick triage 09:00 PT tomorrow. Invite: @Mason @Kei @Pri.

Pri (CS): Process ask: please call out any items that are immediate hard-no so CS stops promising timelines. Kei/legal-bot answered the main one (no raw prompts). Thank you.

Mason (PM): After triage I'll convert NorthNode into a small epic for the aggregated export and draft a compliance checklist for ops-assisted exports.

Pri (CS): great  I'll nudge the A-tier CSMs and update customers with interim options. :thumbsup:
